How to use FINOVA

Log in

Hover over (or tap) the person icon → Log in → enter email and password → Log in. If you forgot it, use "Forgot password?" to verify your email and set a new one.

Create an account

Person icon → Register → name, email, password (8+ chars, letters and numbers).

Plan

Financial Information → fill in data and 3 goals (or import Excel) → Review → Confirm → read the results, run what-if / stress tests, then export Excel.

Log out

Person icon → Log out.

Light / dark

Click the moon (dark) or sun (light).
